CFML Language Reference: Functions

LSNumberFormat

Returns a number as a string, formatted according to a mask, using the decimal point and thousands separator of the current locale. The mask characters are the same as for NumberFormat.

Category

International functions

Syntax

LSNumberFormat(number [, mask ])

Parameters

number
The number to format.
mask
Optional. A NumberFormat mask such as "9,999.99". Without a mask the number is rounded to an integer and thousands separators are added.

Returns

The formatted number as a string.

Usage

KoldFusion formats in English (US) only (see SetLocale), so LSNumberFormat gives the same result as NumberFormat: a period for the decimal point and commas between thousands.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET N = 1234567.891>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Locale: #GetLocale()#</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Mask</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>(none)</TD><TD>#LSNumberFormat(N)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>9,999,999.99</TD><TD>#LSNumberFormat(N, "9,999,999.99")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>9999999.9</TD><TD>#LSNumberFormat(N, "9999999.9")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>(9,999,999)</TD><TD>#LSNumberFormat(-N, "(9,999,999)")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
